Generic inspection reports mutation_supported=false. No terrain write was attempted.

Native capability result

Landscape inspection, preview, apply and job-status MCP tools are exposed, but native admission for this production World Partition world is unavailable under the current grants. Read-only adoption preflight reports target_layer_ready=true, checkpoint_source_clean=true and requires_layer_setup=false. Eligibility and layer readiness do not confer write authorization.

The only request/grant is [redacted], actions=[setup_layer], approved=true, used=true, expired=true. It cannot authorize apply_heightmap. No new request or grant was issued.

A read-only one-sample apply_heightmap preview admission check, using the existing ID, returned:

{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"unsupported_world","message":"Streaming sublevels and World Partition Landscape writes require an exact host-authorized existing-world grant or an approved disposable map."}}

This is an admission rejection before an executable preview was created, not a failed sculpt job. The one-sample request used region [1020,1020,1020,1020], samples_cm=[0] solely to test native admission; it was not a riverbed design, selected safe world-space site or applied deformation. No preview ID, apply call, job ID or height write resulted.

Installed plugin source corroborates the gate: ForgeLandscape.cpp checks World Partition write admission before planning; later existing-world planning requires an active matching host grant or adoption grant. ForgeLandscapeAdoption.inl:20-22 requires approved, unrevoked, unused, unexpired and action-matching authorization. A chat authorization does not create this native state. The earlier setup grant cannot be replayed or expanded.

Intended riverbed and unexecuted stages

Requested target: gently curved approximately 30 m long, 4 m wide and 0.75 m deep, exclusively on ForgeTerrain. No world-space site or final vertex footprint was selected because the essential Phase 1 capability gate failed. No actor-obstruction check, final heightfield generation, fresh sculpt checkpoint, apply, job polling, camera positioning or save followed. Existing checkpoint verification/new sculpt backup stages were not entered; no historical verification is presented as fresh sculpt recovery coverage.

Original and ForgeTerrain before values are recorded above; no after-sculpt values exist. No vertex changes, center depth, bank falloff or out-of-region preservation can be claimed. No screenshot was captured because there is no new Landscape deformation to show. Saved package inventory: none. Production Content modifications by this operation: none.

Precise blocker and stop boundary

Missing capability: an active, unused, action- and region-matching native authorization for apply_heightmap on this exact production World Partition Landscape. The installed workflow provides local approval through an adoption request or exact host-issued authorization, but the task expressly prohibits additional adoption and does not authorize host-configuration changes. No bypass, new request, grant, configuration change, script substitute or rebuild was attempted. No further user approval is requested as part of this stopped task.

City builder was not executed. No new level or Editor, terrain mesh substitute, Original Layer edit, sculpt, save, automatic restore, actor change, HLOD or Stage 2E diagnostic occurred. Stage 2E and Phase 6C acceptance remain separate. The operation stops at the essential native capability failure required by Phase 1.

Full native responses: Evidence [not indexed].
